baseline.scope: Independent owned preparation, complete typed inputs/seeds/radius/B identity, execution order, requested capacity/no-storage-refund, settled known/upper work and whole candidate composition. Protected independent Fraction references validate real child results: six box coordinates use exact quadratic extrema+B; downstream recorded-box integer-RN/root enclosure is separate. Message byte provenance/actual public value bits and actual CPU instruction/compiler binding are separate Native/artifact gates. Same-run sizeof metadata is observational, not heap/stack/allocator bound. No World advance/response, actual fault injection or cross-compiler whole-output bit parity.
